steps.name: stage
argv:
import hashlib, os, urllib.request
base = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/olegmalk/banyan-city/main/"
root = r"C:\banyan-farm\ep2-b06-pose-r4-0822"
want = [
    ("pipeline/controlnet_plate.py", os.path.join(root, "src", "pipeline"),
     "ece54f687d892d1fb1df17211331919bfcb04faac4fe0ee6aa9b0bb231adcc32"),
    ("pipeline/hints/b06-guard-pose-0822.png", root, "1f04f73fd754d6aa72f4f3d1ae535412c35a2c1f643a5a45a6536ed10a2aebb2"),
]
for path, dst, sha in want:
    os.makedirs(dst, exist_ok=True)
    with urllib.request.urlopen(base + path, timeout=120) as r:
        blob = r.read()
    got = hashlib.sha256(blob).hexdigest()
    if got != sha:
        raise SystemExit("!! %s sha %s, wanted %s" % (path, got, sha))
    name = path.rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
    with open(os.path.join(dst, name), "wb") as fh:
        fh.write(blob)
    print("staged", name, got[:12])

steps.name: publish
argv:
# The courier pushes from farm-out and from nowhere else. The two HINTS
# travel with the frame as well as the prompt: a conditioned plate whose
# condition is not beside it cannot be re-read later.
import glob, hashlib, os, shutil
dst = "C:/banyan-farm/courier-box/farm-out/ep2-b06-pose-r4-0822"
os.makedirs(dst, exist_ok=True)
files = sorted(glob.glob("C:/banyan-farm/ep2-b06-pose-r4-0822/out/ep2-b06-pose-r4-0822-posebooth.png*")
               + glob.glob("C:/banyan-farm/ep2-b06-pose-r4-0822/prompt.txt")
               + glob.glob("C:/banyan-farm/ep2-b06-pose-r4-0822/negative.txt")
               + glob.glob("C:/banyan-farm/ep2-b06-pose-r4-0822/b06-guard-pose-0822.png"))
lines = []
for f in files:
    shutil.copy2(f, dst)
    c = os.path.join(dst, os.path.basename(f))
    with open(c, "rb") as fh:
        lines.append(hashlib.sha256(fh.read()).hexdigest() + "  "
                     + os.path.basename(f))
with open(os.path.join(dst, "ep2-b06-pose-r4-0822.sha256"), "w", newline="\n") as fh:
    fh.write("\n".join(sorted(lines)) + "\n")
print("published", len(files), "file(s) + manifest ->", dst)
raise SystemExit(0 if len(files) >= 4 else 1)
